messages:
karen: Quick heads-up — Simone (Prod Eng) handed in resignation yesterday, last day 2026-04-14. Need to lock down benefits end date, COBRA packet timing, SSO/service deprovision, and laptop return logistics. Can we coordinate? :wave:

matt_it: Got it. Which services does Simone use most? I'll triage access list today.

karen: Primary: GitHub org, CI runners, internal build buckets, and AWS prod-read. Also Okta, Slack, and Datadog.

sahana: For benefits: COBRA window starts the day after their last active date per our broker. I can trigger the enrollment email once HR confirms last payroll date. Who is Simone's manager?

karen: Manager is Hugo. Final paycheck runs on next cycle (4/20 payroll) — Holly in payroll confirmed. Please make COBRA effective 4/15 start of eligibility.

jenna_recruiting: I'll set up exit interview scheduling with Simone — prefer 4/13 or 4/14 morning. Also collecting any hiring notes for the backfill.

matt_it: OK. I'll prepare a deprovision ticket and reuse the standard template. Planning to disable interactive sessions at start of last day and revoke API keys at EOD. If anyone needs emergency access earlier, ping me.

karen: Can you paste the deprovision checklist here so I can share with Hugo?

matt_it: Sure — copying minimal checklist: 
```
- Disable Okta account
- Revoke personal SSH keys from prod runners
- Remove from GitHub org (transfer repo ownership where needed)
- Revoke AWS console and API keys; rotate any shared service creds
- Remove Slack account (leave archived messages)
- Reclaim company laptop and peripheral assets
```

sahana: For COBRA packet — need last active date, mailing address, and dependent info confirmation. Simone's address on file is the SF address — I'll DM Simone to confirm.

jenna_recruiting: On knowledge transfer: Hugo will arrange a 2-hour handoff with the team week before last day. I'll add a calendar invite and request a short doc in the team drive.

karen: Thanks. Also note: insurance termination date should align with payroll cutoff to avoid gaps. Sahana — can you confirm with broker that if last day is 4/14, coverage runs through 4/14 and COBRA invite goes out 4/15?

sahana: Yup — I'll confirm and post broker reply here.

matt_it: One more operational note — we'll schedule device return via IT shipping. Simone is remote (Bay Area). I'll open an asset return ticket and include pre-paid label.

it-bot: [automated] Deprovision ticket created: #IT-3421 assigned to matt_it. Asset-return label created: AR-5589.

karen: Perfect. I'll update Hugo and ask him to approve the handoff doc. Please flag anything that needs urgent sign-off. :thumbsup:

jenna_recruiting: I'll also mark the role as "recruiting:paused" until we have Hugo's sign-off on job spec changes.

matt_it: Will post estimated deprovision window once I confirm timing with Hugo — leaning to start at 09:00 on 2026-04-14 with revocations by 17:00.

karen: Great — thanks everyone. I'll follow up after broker confirms COBRA timing.
